name: google-multi-auth
description: Connect more than one Gmail inbox to Claude. Read-only: Claude can search and read your mail, never send or change it.
long_description: Claude's built-in Gmail connector links one Google account at a time. google-multi-auth connects as many Gmail inboxes as you like, so Claude can search a personal and a work account in the same chat. It asks Google for read-only access, keeps your sign-ins on your own computer, and talks to Google directly. After installing, ask Claude to "add my Gmail account" and sign in to each inbox in your browser.

tools.name: add_account
